title: Radish Harbor Ventures
text:
Radish Harbor Ventures

notes:
Inbound: founder Asha Rao signed up for free hosted API trial on 2026-03-05 and ran smoke tests using free credits.
2026-03-07 discovery call (30m) — Founder/CTO Asha Rao led call. AE Maya Chen + SE Ethan Rivera present.
Primary ask: transparent hosted pricing and side-by-side cost comparison vs OpenAI + Anthropic (per-token math + examples for 50k and 500k tokens/mo).
Usage profile: bursty onboarding chat flows; peak 10-50 RPS for short windows; avg message ~150 tokens; expected growth from ~100k to 500k tokens/mo over 3-6 months.
Latency SLO: target 100-200ms p95 for short replies. Cost sensitivity: initial budget target < $2k/mo if MVP economics work.
Model preference: open models are preferred for cost but founder wants quality near gpt-4; open to Redwood-verified model recommendations and streaming support.
Security: SMB baseline — wants SSO (admin), SOC2 attestation, audit logs. No immediate data residency constraints.
Current blockers: confusion around token math, rate limits, and how Redwood hosted delta compares to OpenAI/Anthropic for both cost and latency.
Next steps agreed on call: send SMB hosted_api pricing PDF + concrete cost calc for 100k tokens and for 500k tokens, include recommended model picks and expected p95 latencies; provide quickstart repo so founder can run their sample prompt. Offer 30m follow-up after they test quickstart (week of Mar 22).
Quote from Asha: 'We can grow fast if the unit economics make sense — pricing transparency is make-or-break.'
Stubs/links: Fireflies ff-20260307-8342; Gmail thread thread-CAHV-20260307-ctx; Drive deck drive://redwood/pricing/smb-pricing-v2.pdf; RAD Jira RED-3121 (question re: rate limits).

blockers:
pricing clarity vs OpenAI/Anthropic
confirmation on rate limits
validating 100-200ms p95 latency

next_step:
Send hosted API SMB pricing PDF + sample token cost calc; include recommended model variants and p95 latency estimates; schedule 30m follow-up week of 2026-03-22
